_status_values_comment: SETUP, PLANNED, IN_PROGRESS, VERIFIED, EVALUATED, DONE, FAILED, BLOCKED, PAUSED. FAILED means the work missed its criteria and a fix may be attempted. BLOCKED means it cannot proceed and the system must not try. PAUSED means waiting on allowance, input or approval, and is a normal operating state rather than an error.
